_note: Original practice prompts written for BandUp in the style of IELTS tasks. Not official IELTS material.

W2.text: Some people think cities should ban private cars from their centres entirely. To what extent do you agree or disagree?
More and more students take online degrees instead of attending a university in person. Do the advantages of this outweigh the disadvantages?
Many young people now work for themselves as freelancers rather than for a company. Why is this happening, and is it a positive or negative development?
Some argue that governments should spend money on public transport rather than on building new roads. Discuss both views and give your own opinion.
In many countries, people are living longer but retiring at the same age. What problems does this cause, and what can be done about them?
Social media companies should be responsible for the false information that appears on their platforms. To what extent do you agree or disagree?
Some people believe children should learn to manage money at school, while others think this is the job of parents. Discuss both views and give your own opinion.
Tourism brings money to developing countries, but it can also damage local culture and the environment. Do the benefits outweigh the drawbacks?
Artificial intelligence will soon do many jobs that people do today. What effects will this have on society, and how should individuals prepare?
Some people think that the best way to reduce crime is to give longer prison sentences. Others believe there are better ways. Discuss both views and give your opinion.
Fewer people read books for pleasure than in the past. Why is this, and does it matter?
Countries should produce all the food they need rather than importing it. To what extent do you agree or disagree?

W1A.text: The table shows the percentage of households in one city that used each way to get to work in 2005 and 2025. Car: 58% then 41%. Bus: 22% then 19%. Bicycle: 6% then 17%. Walking: 9% then 11%. Metro: 5% then 12%. Summarise the information by selecting and reporting the main features, and make comparisons where relevant.

The line graph shows average monthly rainfall (mm) in two cities, Port Avel and Dunmore, across one year. Port Avel: Jan 20, Mar 35, May 180, Jul 320, Sep 210, Nov 40. Dunmore: Jan 90, Mar 75, May 60, Jul 45, Sep 70, Nov 100. Summarise the information by selecting and reporting the main features, and make comparisons where relevant.

The process: how recycled glass bottles become new bottles. 1 collection from homes, 2 sorting by colour at a depot, 3 washing, 4 crushing into small pieces called cullet, 5 melting at 1,500 C with sand and soda ash, 6 moulding into bottles, 7 cooling and quality check, 8 delivery to drinks companies. Summarise the information by selecting and reporting the main features.

The bar chart shows how many hours per week people in four age groups spent on screens for leisure in 2015 and 2025. Age 16-24: 21 then 34. 25-39: 17 then 26. 40-59: 12 then 19. 60+: 8 then 15. Summarise the information by selecting and reporting the main features, and make comparisons where relevant.

W1G.text: You recently stayed at a hotel and left a valuable item in your room. Write a letter to the hotel manager. In your letter: describe the item, explain when and where you think you left it, and say what you would like the hotel to do.

A friend is coming to work in your city for six months. Write a letter to your friend. In your letter: suggest an area to live in, give advice about getting around, and recommend something to do at weekends.

Your neighbour has started building work that is causing problems for you. Write a letter to your neighbour. In your letter: describe the problems, explain how they affect you, and suggest a solution.

S2.text: Describe a skill you learned outside school. You should say: what the skill is, who taught you or how you learned it, how long it took, and explain why this skill is useful to you.
Describe a time you helped someone. You should say: who you helped, what the problem was, what you did, and explain how you felt afterwards.
Describe a place in your city where people go to relax. You should say: where it is, what it looks like, what people do there, and explain why it is popular.
Describe a piece of technology you could not live without. You should say: what it is, when you started using it, how often you use it, and explain why it matters so much to you.
Describe a goal you have that you have not achieved yet. You should say: what the goal is, when you set it, what you are doing to reach it, and explain why it is important to you.
Describe a memorable meal you had. You should say: where you were, who you were with, what you ate, and explain why you remember it.
Describe a person who has influenced the way you work or study. You should say: who the person is, how you know them, what they do, and explain how they have influenced you.
Describe a journey that took longer than expected. You should say: where you were going, how you travelled, what caused the delay, and explain how you felt about it.
